battle.name: 阿爾及利亞戰爭
battle.theater: 阿爾及利亞北部沿海與卡比利亞山區
battle.brief: 一九五四年十一月一日夜間，民族解放陣線在三十餘座城鎮同時開火，阿爾及利亞戰爭開打；法軍以 MAS-36 步槍配給基層步兵班，在海岸城鎮與卡比利亞山區展開七年清剿，最終一九六二年三月停火、七月五日建國。

kit.name: MAS-36步槍
kit.history: MAS‑36是法國軍隊在二戰期間採用的標準栓式步槍，採用7.5mm口徑，於步兵班中作為主要單兵武器，提供中距離精確射擊能力。

countries: 交戰的兩方是法國國家與阿爾及利亞民族解放陣線。阿爾及利亞自一八三〇年法軍入城起屬法國，一九五四年時是法屬北非三省的阿爾及利亞，法國本土與殖民地共用一套軍事架構：國防部與參謀總部在本土調配兵員與裝備，總督府與法國阿爾及利亞參謀長分轄各師團，師團下轄營連，營連才是步槍的實際使用單位。駐阿爾及利亞的法軍包括阿爾及利亞師團、北非師團、外國兵團第一團、第二團與第三團、阿爾及爾空降第十師，以及摩洛哥與突尼斯的邊防部隊；一九五八年投入「安撫」行動的兵力約四十萬。輔助兵力有法國穆斯林哈基斯約六萬人、摩扎比地區的民兵，另有約九千人的流動農村保護小組，各村自衛團體合計約六萬人，其中約三萬人由法國提供武器。另一方是民族解放陣線：一九五四年十月由團結與行動革命委員會改組而成，以民族解放軍為軍事骨架，把全境劃為六個軍區——第一軍區奧雷斯由本布萊德掌、第二軍區君士坦丁北部由比塔特掌、第三軍區卡比利亞由克里姆·貝爾卡塞姆掌、第四軍區阿爾及爾由迪杜什掌、第五軍區奧蘭由拉爾比·本·穆希迪掌；突尼斯與摩洛哥設境外基地，一九五八年在開羅成立阿爾及利亞共和國臨時政府，另有武裝自衛隊配合農村游擊。還有第三股力量：反對獨立的歐裔殖民者與部分法國軍官於一九六一年組成秘密軍事組織，曾企圖在阿爾及爾與巴黎奪取政權。
countriesEn: The two sides were the French state and the National Liberation Front of Algeria. Algeria had belonged to France since the French entry into Algiers in 1830, and in 1954 it was the territory of French North Africa with three departments, so the metropolitan country and the colony shared a single military apparatus: the Ministry of Defence and the General Staff allocated men and materiel from the homeland, while the governor's office and the French commander in Algeria distributed the army corps, and the corps into battalions and companies, the company being the unit in which the rifle was actually carried. The French forces in Algeria included the Algerian corps, the North African corps, the first, second and third regiments of the Foreign Legion, the 10th Airborne Division at Algiers, and the frontier forces in Morocco and Tunisia; about four hundred thousand men were committed to pacification by 1958. Auxiliaries included some sixty thousand French Muslim harkis, militias in the M'zab region, about nine thousand men in the mobile rural protection groups, and village self-defence groups totalling some sixty thousand, of whom roughly thirty thousand were armed by France. The other side was the National Liberation Front, reconstituted in October 1954 from the Revolutionary Committee for Unity and Action, built on the National Liberation Army as its military skeleton and dividing the country into six wilayas: the first, the Aurès, under Ben Boulaïd; the second, northern Constantine, under Rabah Bitat; the third, Kabylie, under Krim Belkacem; the fourth, Algiers, under Didouche Mourad; the fifth, Oran, under Larbi Ben M'hidi. Bases were established in Tunisia and Morocco, the Provisional Government of the Algerian Republic was set up in Cairo in 1958, and armed self-defence groups assisted the rural guerrillas. A third force also appeared: European settlers opposed to independence and some French officers formed the Organisation armée secrète in 1961, and attempted to seize power in Algiers and in Paris.
people: 阿爾及利亞一方的領袖層幾乎全在戰前被逮捕或流亡海外。一九五四年七月二十五日，馬達尼亞的 Clos Salambier 別墅裏，五位後來被稱為「五人組」的人物——穆斯塔法·本布萊德、穆罕默德·布迪亞夫、拉爾比·本·穆希迪、迪杜什·穆拉德與拉巴赫·比塔特——商定了武裝起義的路線；十月十五日，團結與行動革命委員會改組為民族解放陣線，五人分掌各軍區，迪杜什並在開羅電台播報起義消息。迪杜什與本·穆希迪相繼在戰鬥中陣亡，本布萊德於一九五六年在突尼斯的空襲中身亡；布迪亞夫與艾哈邁德·本貝拉、艾哈邁德·本阿邁德、克里姆·貝爾卡塞姆等人組成開羅派，一九五八年九月在開羅建立阿爾及利亞共和國臨時政府，一九六二年出任國家首腦。卡比利亞一線以雅塞夫·薩阿迪為首，他一九五七年九月在阿爾及爾城區一處藏身處被第十空降師攻破時落網，其後被處決；哈西巴·本布萊德長期主持城市游擊網。卡比利亞還有莫昂·烏爾哈吉等地方領袖，第四軍區代理負責人西·薩拉赫一九五九年五月起即與法方直接談判。法國一方，總督雅克·馬絮與參謀長保羅·埃利先後主持「安撫」政策；一九五七年沙勒將軍接任參謀長，推行以情報與機動為核心的沙勒計劃，戰術上倚重比雅爾上校在阿德拉爾森林的第三海軍空降連、阿爾及爾的第一外國空降兵突擊隊等單位。密特朗在第四共和國任內政部長期間，批准了在阿爾及爾城區「洗衣街」的刑訊逼供。一九六一年秘密軍事組織策動阿爾及爾與巴黎的軍事政變，拉烏爾·薩朗與讓-雅克·德讓納是核心人物。一九六二年三月戴高樂在愛麗舍宮密會本貝拉，談成停火。
peopleEn: Almost the whole leadership of the Algerian side was in prison before the war or in exile abroad. On 25 July 1954, in the Clos Salambier villa at Madania, five men who would be called the famous five — Mustapha Ben Boulaïd, Mohamed Boudiaf, Larbi Ben M'hidi, Didouche Mourad and Rabah Bitat — settled the line of the armed rising; on 15 October the Revolutionary Committee for Unity and Action became the National Liberation Front, the five took charge of the wilayas, and Didouche broadcast the news of the rising from the Cairo radio. Didouche and Ben M'hidi were killed in action, and Ben Boulaïd died in an air raid in Tunisia in 1956. Boudiaf, together with Ahmed Ben Bella, Hocine Aït Ahmed and Krim Belkacem, formed the Cairo group; in September 1958 they set up the Provisional Government of the Algerian Republic in Cairo, and in 1962 they became the heads of the new state. In Kabylie the network was led by Yacef Saadi, who was captured in September 1957 when the 10th Airborne Division blew up his hideout in the city of Algiers, and was later executed; Hassiba Ben Boulaïd ran the urban guerrilla network for years. Kabylie also had local leaders such as Moahrane Ourhaci, and in the fourth wilaya the acting chief, Si Saalah, entered direct negotiations with the French from May 1959. On the French side, the governor Jacques Massu and the commander in chief Paul Ely directed the pacification in turn; in 1957 General Challe took over as commander in chief and imposed the Challe plan built on intelligence and mobility, relying tactically on units such as Colonel Bigeard's 3rd Naval Parachute Company in the Adrar forest and the 1st Foreign Airborne Commando company at Algiers. During the Fourth Republic, Mitterrand, as Minister of the Interior, authorised the use of torture for interrogations in the rue de la Fontaine in Algiers. In 1961 the Organisation armée secrète staged military coups in Algiers and in Paris, with Raoul Salan and Jean-Jacques Degenne at its centre. In March 1962 de Gaulle met Ben Bella secretly at the Élysée and a ceasefire was agreed.
kits: MAS-36 是法軍在這場戰爭中人手一支的步槍。它一九三六年定裝，二戰期間在沙特爾羅等地的工廠量產，總產量以百萬計，口徑七點五乘五四公釐，槍身下掛刺刀，可用橋夾壓入十發，也可單發裝填，全槍重約四公斤，槍長一公尺出頭，兩百至四百公尺內可作有效射擊。步兵班以它為骨幹，班內另配 MAS-38 短槍、MAS-49 輕機槍與 MAC 式重機槍；師以上有 105 毫米 1937 年型野戰榴彈砲、155 毫米榴彈砲，裝甲方面有 EBR 輪式裝甲車、AMX-13 步兵戰車與 M3 史都溫輕坦，航空方面以「老鴿子」型與「小茴香」型直升機構成低空支援，並大量使用噴火器材與催淚瓦斯。軍需體系龐大，兵員、物資、燃料與曳引車全靠海運從馬賽與奧蘭上岸，因此港口與鐵路是游擊的首要目標。對 FLN 一方而言，MAS-36 與 MAS-38 恰恰是最重要的繳獲物：山地游擊隊沒有自產武器，一九五五年十月莫斯特加內姆伏擊戰之後，繳獲的法軍步槍成為游擊隊第一批像樣的步槍；其後從突尼斯與摩洛哥運入的武器，也以法式步槍與輕機槍為大宗，一九五七年之後埃及、中國、捷克斯洛伐克等國供應的武器陸續到達。裝備的另一端是莫里斯防線：自地中海至撒哈拉邊界的通電鐵絲網與地雷帶，是這場戰爭裡最特別的一件「武器」，它同時是障礙、偵測器與殘害工具。此外還有燃油與藥品的限制，戰後期法軍車隊因燃料短缺而改用加油車巡邏，FLN 則在接管油礦後以石油收入維持作戰。
kitsEn: The MAS-36 was the rifle one man in the French army carried throughout this war. It was adopted in 1936 and mass-produced in factories such as Châtellerault during the Second World War, with production in the millions; the cartridge was 7.5 x 54 mm, a bayonet was carried under the barrel, the magazine could be loaded singly or with a ten-round charger, the rifle weighed about four kilograms and was a little over a metre long, and it was effective out to between two hundred and four hundred metres. The infantry section was built around it, with the MAS-38 carbine, the MAS-49 light machine gun and the MAC heavy machine gun inside the section; above division level came the 105 mm Mle 1937 field howitzer and 155 mm howitzers, while armour comprised EBR wheeled armoured cars, AMX-13 infantry fighting vehicles and M3 Stuart light tanks, and aviation was provided by Alouette and Djinn helicopters for low-level support, together with flame-thrower equipment and tear gas in large quantities. The logistics system was enormous: men, supplies, fuel and recovery vehicles all came in by sea from Marseille and Oran, so ports and railways were the prime targets of the guerrillas. For the FLN, the MAS-36 and the MAS-38 were precisely the most important captures: the mountain guerrillas had no arms of their own, and after the ambush at Mostaganem in October 1955 the captured French rifles became the guerrillas' first serviceable infantry weapons. Later, the weapons sent in from Tunisia and Morocco were largely French rifles and light machine guns, and from 1957 onwards supplies from Egypt, China and Czechoslovakia began to arrive. At the other end of the equipment scale stood the Morice line: the electrified wire and the mine belt running from the Mediterranean to the edge of the Sahara, the most unusual single weapon of this war, serving at once as an obstacle, a detector and an instrument of destruction. There were also limits of fuel and medicines: late in the war French vehicle columns patrolled with bowsers because fuel was short, while the FLN, having taken over the oil fields, paid for its operations out of petroleum revenue.
tactics: FLN 的戰術起於破壞與全民動員：初期以小組作戰、夜襲、伏擊交通線、割斷通訊與水利設施為主，使法軍無法分辨游擊隊與村落。一九五六年前後，FLN 自己在奧雷斯山區推行焦土政策，把居民遷往山區、燒掉房屋與莊稼，理由是只有讓法軍守不住村莊，游擊才能延續；這項政策同時把大量民眾推向對立面，也讓法軍得以用清剿村莊的辦法反過來消耗其群眾基礎。法軍的戰術在沙勒計劃下轉向情報與機動：以聯合協調中心彙整情報，作戰保護小組為各部隊引路，狩獵突擊隊由法國穆斯林與正規軍混編，直升機把突擊隊在數小時內送到山地，再由步槍與機槍解決遭遇戰。城市戰另有一套打法：一九五七年阿爾及爾城區戰役中，第十空降師與外國空降兵部隊逐條街巷封鎖、逐棟搜索，靠夜間突擊與情報網配合，把城市游擊網一個節點一個節點拔除；同時在城區設置刑訊逼供據點以榨取情報，這套辦法短期內奏效，卻同時敗壞法方在國內與國際上的名聲。邊境戰是另一場硬仗：FLN 每月的武裝小組穿越莫里斯防線，把武器運入第二與第三軍區，法軍以雷達、砲火與地雷帶攔截，一九五七年秋天一個月就有兩千件以上武器越境，雙方在鐵絲網與地雷之間反覆爭奪通道。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the FLN began with destruction and with the mobilisation of the population: in the first phase it relied on small cells, night attacks, ambushes of transport routes, the cutting of communications and of water installations, so that the French army could not tell guerrillas from villages. Around 1956 the FLN itself carried out a scorched-earth policy in the Aurès, moving the inhabitants up into the mountains and burning houses and crops, on the argument that only by denying the French army its villages could the guerrilla continue; the policy at the same time drove much of the population to the opposite side and gave the French army the excuse to clear the villages in reverse, thereby eating into the guerrillas' own social base. French tactics turned under the Challe plan towards intelligence and mobility: intelligence was pooled in the joint coordination centre, operational protection sections guided the units, hunting strike squads mixed French Muslims with regular troops, and helicopters delivered those squads into the mountains within hours, where rifles and machine guns settled the engagement. Urban warfare followed a different script: in the battle for Algiers in 1957 the 10th Airborne Division and the Foreign Airborne troops sealed street by street and searched building by building, using night raids and an intelligence network to pull the urban guerrilla network out node by node; at the same time interrogation centres were set up in the city to extract information. The method worked in the short term and ruined French standing at home and abroad at once. The frontier was a different hard war: armed groups of the FLN crossed the Morice line every month to bring weapons into the second and third wilayas, the French answering with radar, artillery and the mine belt, and in the autumn of 1957 more than two thousand weapons crossed in a single month, both sides fighting for the gaps through the wire and the mines.
data: 可核對的數字集中在幾個節點上。起事規模：一九五四年十月三十一日至十一月一日夜間，全境三十餘處同時發生襲擊，官方公布的死亡為八人。兵力：一九五八年前後法軍用於「安撫」的兵力約四十萬；法國穆斯林哈基斯約六萬人，另有約九千人的流動農村保護小組，各村自衛團體合計約六萬人。邊境：一九五七年秋每月有兩千件以上武器越過突尼斯邊界；一九五六年至一九五七年由摩洛哥與突尼斯進入阿爾及利亞的武器約一萬五千件。莫里斯防線自一九五七年九月十五日通電啟用，電網高約二點四米、電壓五千伏，東段自地中海延伸至撒哈拉邊界約四百六十公里；一九五八年至一九六二年在東段埋設地雷三百三十餘萬枚，長約一千二百公里，全戰爭地雷總數約六百二十萬枚，其中人員殺傷地雷四十萬枚、照明地雷二十三萬枚。戰果與損失：一九五七年法軍在阿爾及爾城區戰役中打死 FLN 戰士一千八百二十七人，其中二百餘人陣亡、二百五十三人被俘，另清剿宣傳與後勤人員若干，繳獲武器八百一十二件、炸彈八十八枚、炸藥二百公斤；邊境戰役中法軍陣亡二百七十三人、受傷八百人，FLN 方面近四千人陣亡、五百九十人被俘。停火前法軍作戰死亡一萬六千一百五十四人，其中歐洲法籍九千八百九十九人、法國穆斯林四千五百四十五人、外國兵團一千二百人、非洲籍五百一十人，另有應徵兵九百四十九人；法國本土用於關押疑似 FLN 成員的營地先後關押約一萬四千人。停火時點：《埃維昂協議》一九六二年三月十八日簽訂，三月十九日零時停火；法國本土公投四月八日，約九成一贊成；阿爾及利亞公投七月一日，贊成獨立的比率達百分之九十九點七二；九月十日至十一日，聯合國大會先後通過兩項決議，將阿爾及利亞問題列入議程並支持談判。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster around a few nodes. The scale of the rising: on the night of 31 October to 1 November 1954 more than thirty places across the country were attacked at once, and the official death toll was eight. Manpower: by 1958 roughly four hundred thousand men were committed to pacification; there were some sixty thousand French Muslim harkis, around nine thousand men in the mobile rural protection groups, and village self-defence groups totalling about sixty thousand. The frontier: in the autumn of 1957 more than two thousand weapons crossed the Tunisian border every month, and between 1956 and 1957 about fifteen thousand weapons entered Algeria from Morocco and Tunisia. The Morice line was electrified and declared operational on 15 September 1957, its fence about 2.4 metres high at 5,000 volts, the eastern section running some 460 kilometres from the Mediterranean to the edge of the Sahara; between 1958 and 1962 more than 3.3 million mines were laid along the eastern section over about 1,200 kilometres, and the total for the war was about 6.2 million mines, of which 400,000 were antipersonnel mines and 230,000 illumination mines. Results and losses: in the battle for Algiers in 1957 the French killed 1,827 FLN fighters, of whom more than two hundred were killed in action and 253 captured, together with a number of propaganda and logistics personnel, and seized 812 weapons, 88 bombs and 200 kilograms of explosive; in the frontier fighting the French lost 273 men killed and 800 wounded, while the ALN lost close to four thousand dead and 590 captured. Before the ceasefire 16,154 French troops died in combat, of whom 9,899 were of European origin, 4,545 French Muslims, 1,200 Foreign Legion and 510 African, with a further 949 conscripts; camps in metropolitan France held about 14,000 persons suspected of being FLN members. The ceasefire dates: the Evian Accords were signed on 18 March 1962 and the ceasefire took effect at midnight on 19 March; the referendum in France on 8 April approved them by about ninety-one per cent; the referendum in Algeria on 1 July returned 99.72 per cent in favour of independence; and on 10 and 11 September the United Nations General Assembly passed two resolutions placing Algeria on the agenda and supporting negotiation.
cause: 起因有遠近兩層。近因是一九四五年塞提夫慘案與同年君士坦丁的清剿，北非師團在城鎮廣場向人群開火，把原本分散的怨恨匯成一條線；一九四九年《柏柏爾宣言》要求承認柏柏爾人的文化與語言權利，一九五二年法國議會在處理阿爾及利亞議案時反覆高喊「阿爾及利亞是法國的」，等於向本地菁英宣告沒有協商的餘地；當時在阿爾及利亞唯一合法存在的武裝團體就是法國軍隊本身，青年若要武裝就只能通敵或上山。遠因是制度本身：阿爾及利亞居民沒有投票權，穆斯林不能入法籍，本地菁英只能靠法語學校與法國文憑取得地位，土地集中於歐裔殖民者手中，一九四八年以後的經濟計畫雖帶來工業化，卻同時把農地收歸國家、把佃農推向邊緣。外部原因是冷戰：情報機關不斷誇大開羅與莫斯科的介入規模，使法國相信阿爾及利亞存在一個由外部支持的顛覆集團；而聯合國在巴勒斯坦與印度支那的處置顯示殖民體系正在退潮，一九五四年日內瓦會議討論印度支那與朝鮮，蘇伊士運河在埃及納賽爾收購股份的宣布更使法國在阿拉伯世界的聲望下降，開羅於是成了 FLN 的天然後盾。
causeEn: The cause had an immediate and a remote layer. The immediate one was the Sétif massacre of 1945 and the repression in Constantine in the same year, when North African troops fired on crowds in town squares and drew scattered grievances into a single line; the Berber Manifesto of 1949 demanded recognition of Berber cultural and linguistic rights, and in 1952 the French parliament, handling Algerian business, repeated the cry that Algeria was France, which told the local elite that there was no room for negotiation; at that moment the only armed body legally present in Algeria was the French army itself, so any young man who wanted a gun had either to go over to the rebels or up into the mountains. The remote cause was the system: the Algerian population had no vote, Muslims could not obtain French nationality, the local elite could rise only through French-language schools and French credentials, and land was concentrated in European hands; the economic plans after 1948 brought industrialisation but also nationalised the farmland and pushed tenant farmers to the margins. The external cause was the Cold War: the intelligence services systematically exaggerated the scale of Cairo's and Moscow's involvement, so that France came to believe a subverted group directed from abroad was at work in Algeria. Meanwhile the United Nations handling of Palestine and Indochina showed the colonial system in retreat, the 1954 Geneva Conference discussed Indochina and Korea, and Nasser's announcement of the Egyptian purchase of the Suez Canal shares cost France standing in the Arab world, which made Cairo the FLN's natural protector.
impact: 影響有三層，都越出阿爾及利亞本身。第一層是法國的政體：戰爭的財政與道義負擔，加上一九五八年五月十三日阿爾及爾的軍事政變與第四共和國的崩潰，讓戴高樂在第五共和國下取得非常權力；軍隊在一九六一年兩次政變中的表現，又使法國此後對軍隊的政治角色長期保持戒心，專業化與去政治化同時發生。第二層是去殖民化的地圖：一九六〇年聯合國大會通過第1514號決議，一九六二年阿爾及利亞獲得獨立，緊接着葡屬安哥拉與莫桑比克、幾內亞、肯尼亞與坦尚尼亞陸續獨立，非洲殖民地在六十年代中期基本清空；FLN 在開羅、突尼斯、摩洛哥與亞的斯亞貝巴的後勤與訓練網，後來成了安哥拉、莫桑比克與剛果游擊隊的支撐。第三層是記憶與法律：《埃維昂協議》的大赦條款使雙方的戰時行為無法追訴，法國直到一九八八年才在法律上承認阿爾及利亞戰爭中的戰俘身份，一九九二年開放部分檔案後，酷刑與戰爭罪的學術討論才重新展開；對法國本土而言，這場戰爭留下的是兵役世代的沉默、退役軍人的憤怒與「被背叛」的敘事，對阿爾及利亞而言，則是一個以戰爭記憶為立國基礎、軍人長期占據政治中心的國家。
impactEn: The impact had three layers, all of them reaching beyond Algeria itself. The first was the form of the French state: the financial and moral weight of the war, together with the military coup of 13 May 1958 in Algiers and the collapse of the Fourth Republic, gave de Gaulle exceptional power under the Fifth Republic; the part played by the army in the two coups of 1961 in turn left France permanently wary of the political role of its military, so that professionalisation and depoliticisation went ahead together. The second was the map of decolonisation: the General Assembly adopted Resolution 1514 in 1960, Algeria became independent in 1962, and Portuguese Angola and Mozambique, Guinea, Kenya and Tanzania followed in quick succession, emptying the map of colonial Africa by the middle of the decade; the logistics and training network the FLN had built in Cairo, Tunis, Rabat and Addis Ababa later became the support system for the guerrillas of Angola, Mozambique and the Congo. The third was memory and law: the amnesty clauses of the Evian Accords made the wartime conduct of both sides unpunishable, and France did not legally recognise the prisoners of the Algerian War until 1988, while the academic discussion of torture and war crimes only reopened after the partial opening of the archives in 1992. For metropolitan France the war left the silence of the conscript generation, the anger of the veterans and a narrative of betrayal; for Algeria it left a state founded on a memory of war in which the military long occupied the centre of politics.
result: 結果是法軍的撤退與一個新國家的誕生。軍事上，法軍在阿爾及爾城區與邊境兩場硬仗都佔上風，莫里斯防線切斷了 FLN 的外來補給，一九五八年的整頓與一九五九年游擊戰術的轉向卻無法扭轉局勢；一九五九年八月比雅爾上校在賽伊達向戴高樂直言，平靜仍像海市蜃樓一樣遙遠，政變與軍人能量的結合仍可逆轉政治局面。法國的選擇是用政治換時間：一九五九年戴高樂提出阿爾及利亞人自決，一九六一年元月舉行公投，同年三月開羅派在突尼斯直接與法方接觸，一九六二年三月十八日《埃維昂協議》在巴黎西南部的埃維昂簽訂，規定停火、法軍撤退、阿爾及利亞在三年內舉行自決公投、軍隊逐步解散。停火定於三月十九日零時生效，法國本土四月八日公投以約九成一通過，阿爾及利亞七月一日公投以百分之九十九點七二通過，七月五日主權移交完成，阿爾及利亞共和國成立，本貝拉出任總理，民族解放軍解散後改編為國民軍。協議未能阻止暗殺與報復，秘密軍事組織在巴布瓦德一線與法軍交火，停火後雙方都有法外制裁。一九六三年停火協議大致劃定邊界，而戰爭留下的裝備、經驗與地雷帶，在往後數十年裡繼續影響兩國的安全。
resultEn: The result was the withdrawal of the French forces and the birth of a new country. Militarily the French won the hard fights in the city of Algiers and on the frontier, and the Morice line cut the FLN off from outside supply, but the reorganisation of 1958 and the change of guerrilla method in 1959 could not turn the situation around; in August 1959 Colonel Bigeard told de Gaulle at Saïda that peace still seemed to recede like a mirage and that the combination of the army's energy with a coup remained a possibility. France's answer was to buy time by politics: de Gaulle proposed self-determination for the Algerians in 1959, a referendum was held in January 1961, in March of that year the Cairo group made direct contact with the French in Tunis, and on 18 March 1962 the Evian Accords were signed at Évian near Paris, providing for a ceasefire, the withdrawal of the French forces, a self-determination referendum in Algeria within three years and the progressive dissolution of the army. The ceasefire took effect at midnight on 19 March, the French referendum of 8 April passed the accords by about ninety-one per cent, the Algerian referendum of 1 July returned 99.72 per cent in favour, and on 5 July the transfer of sovereignty was completed and the Algerian Republic was proclaimed, with Ben Bella as prime minister and the National Liberation Army dissolved into the National Army. The agreements did not prevent assassination and reprisal: the Organisation armée secrète fought the French troops in the Bab el Oued district, and after the ceasefire both sides carried out killings outside the accord. The 1963 agreements drew the frontier, while the weapons, the experience and the mine belts left by the war went on shaping the security of both countries for decades to come.
